summary: Iteration 4 full backend + frontend test pass — email verification gating, trust points, AI Coach, AI vetting task, full profile page, and theme swap all working end-to-end.

backend: GET /api/auth/me returns new shape (email_verified, trust_points, social_links, former_projects, cv_url, age, phone, location, languages, hourly_rate).
Demo client@demo.com has email_verified=true and trust_points=10 (email-verified ladder step).
POST /api/projects with unverified user → 403 ('verify your email…').
POST /api/auth/send-verification stores 6-digit code in db.email_codes; backend log line '[verify] code for …' present.
POST /api/auth/verify-email with wrong code 5x → final attempt 429 (Too many attempts).
Resend code then verify with correct code → 200, email_verified flips to true.
PATCH /api/users/me accepts age, phone, location, languages, hourly_rate, cv_url, social_links, former_projects, bio, skills and recomputes trust_points on save.
Trust ladder monotonic and capped at 100 across 9 incremental field additions.
POST /api/ai/chat with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY + gpt-4o-mini returns non-empty reply + session_id.
POST /api/ai/vetting-task (paid + in_progress project, owner) returns JSON with title/goal/tasks/evaluation_criteria/time_estimate_minutes.
frontend: Theme: body bg rgb(15, 23, 42) (== #0F172A), font-family Manrope loaded. Primary CTA blue with ~12px rounded corners verified visually.
Header avatar (initial circle) opens dropdown with: name, email, 'Trust 55/100' chip, 'Profile management', 'Dashboard', 'Post a brief', 'Log out'.
/profile renders TrustRing (data-testid=trust-ring), Wins counter (data-testid=profile-wins), Save button (data-testid=profile-save-btn).

All sections render: Avatar / Identity (phone/age/location/languages/hourly_rate) / CV-Resume / Social presence (LinkedIn/Twitter/Instagram/Behance/GitHub/Website) / Portfolio / Former projects / Trust ladder.
Clicking Save profile shows 'Profile saved · trust points recalculated.' toast and ladder steps light up green.
Verified user's profile correctly hides data-testid=profile-verify-email-btn.

AI Coach floating button (data-testid=ai-chat-toggle) at bottom-right opens panel (data-testid=ai-chat-panel). Sending 'Hi, one short tip on pricing my first logo brief?' renders user bubble + AI reply bubble with real LLM content.
Regression: Login, Dashboard ('As Client (3)' with cards), Browse all load without console errors.

critical_code_review_comments: Sign-in button on /login is not `type="submit"` — Enter key in password field still works, but `button[type=submit]` selectors fail. Minor maintainability concern; consider adding type='submit' for accessibility/keyboard a11y consistency.
Header avatar trigger button has no data-testid (only the last header `button`). Adding data-testid='avatar-menu-trigger' would improve test stability.

compute_trust counts both '>=2 socials' (+5) AND '>=4 socials' (+5) cumulatively — works as designed, but the Trust Ladder UI labels both '2+ social links' and '4+ social links' which is clearer than the implementation comment suggests; no bug.

issue_email_code logs the OTP at INFO ('[verify] code for X: 123456'). Intended for sandbox per the prompt, but should be DEBUG-only or gated by an env flag before any production rollout to avoid leaking codes in logs.
/api/files/{path} `auth` query-string fallback path swallows JWT decode errors with bare `Exception` — fine, but consider logging at WARNING for observability of token-format issues.
seed_data_creation: Test added bio/skills/socials/former_projects/cv_url/phone to client@demo.com (TrustRing now reads 55/100 instead of original 10). One TEST_iter4_* project was created by the verified-create-project test and left in db.projects. Cleanup of TEST_trust_* users handled in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_rivalo_iter4.py run cleanly via `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_rivalo_iter4.py -v`. Reads MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from env, uses pymongo to read OTP codes directly from db.email_codes. AI tests take ~10s for chat and ~30s for vetting task. Demo client now has profile fields populated by tests; if you need a baseline-trust=10 client, reset its profile fields. Email verify button (data-testid=profile-verify-email-btn) only renders for unverified users — register a fresh account to UI-test VerifyEmailModal.
